faq.q: What's FinOps and why does it matter?
a: FinOps (Financial Operations) is the practice of bringing accountability and visibility to cloud spend. Most enterprises waste 30-40% on idle resources and oversized instances. FinOps fixes this through cost allocation, reserved instances, and automation, without cutting features.

faq.q: How much can we save with FinOps?
a: Typically 30-40% of cloud spend. For a $1M/month cloud bill, that's $300-400K annually. Most savings come from: reserved instances (10-15%), Spot instances (10-15%), right-sizing (5-10%), and storage optimisation (5%).

faq.q: Will FinOps slow down our teams?
a: No. Good FinOps is invisible to development teams. We implement cost-aware policies via Terraform/Infrastructure-as-Code, so teams stay agile while costs stay controlled. Automation > manual enforcement.

faq.q: How do you handle multi-cloud FinOps?
a: We audit all clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP) together, allocate costs fairly across teams, and apply consistent policies. Tools like Vantage or CloudZero give unified visibility, then we enforce commitment discounts across all platforms.
